name: privasearch
description: Privacy-first AI search: SearXNG + Ollama + RAG. Cross-platform npm scripts (Windows-friendly alternative to the Makefile).

scripts.up-vpn: node scripts/gen-secret.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.vpn.yml up -d --build
scripts.up-tor: node scripts/gen-secret.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.tor.yml up -d --build
scripts.vpn-ip: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.vpn.yml exec gluetun sh -c "wget -qO- https://ipinfo.io/ip"
scripts.tor-ip: docker run --rm --network privasearch_privanet curlimages/curl:latest -s --socks5-hostname tor:9050 https://ipinfo.io/ip
scripts.pull-model: docker compose up -d ollama && docker compose exec ollama ollama pull qwen2.5:1.5b
